empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: A skill body is injected into the agent's prompt as INSTRUCTIONS, not wrapped as untrusted data — read it before enabling.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body reaches the model as instructions (not delimiter-wrapped data), so it stays disabled until you read it and enable it yourself.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — write it directively. It's what tells an agent when to reach for this skill, not a summary of the body.
config.sourceHint: Set on import; a skill can't change its own source.
config.bodyHint: Injected into the prompt verbatim when this skill is enabled and linked. Changing it creates a new version.
config.disabledHint: Disabled skills are linked but never reach the prompt.
config.vettingHint: Imported from an untrusted source — read the body before enabling.

preview.title: Preview
preview.body: Rendered exactly as it appears in the assembled prompt, inside “## Skills / rules”.
preview.disabledNote: This skill is disabled — it is not currently injected into any prompt.

stats.title: Stats
stats.correlationNote: In runs with this skill — not necessarily found BECAUSE of it. The model sees the whole prompt at once.

versions.title: Version history
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This creates a new version with v{version}'s body — it does not delete history.
versions.noChanges: No differences — the body is identical.

import.modalSubtitleFile: Reads a local Markdown file. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
import.modalSubtitleArchive: Reads local .md files out of a .zip. Anything else in the archive is dropped and never sent.
import.dropHint: Drop a file here, or click to choose one
import.tooLarge: That file is larger than the {maxMb} MB import limit.
import.tooManyEntries: That archive has more than {max} entries.
import.nameHint: Derived from frontmatter, the first heading, or the filename.
import.vettingNote: Imported skills are stored disabled. Vet the body, then enable it here or in the editor.
import.confirm: Import {count, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}}
